items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was driving with Don Murphy? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, with Earl Murphy.

ctx.x: And we didn't find out til later what it was, that it was this conversation that was driving him up the wall. And an interesting story about this is that, years later, it was little George Finola that was in the car, and Hillard is in the front with Murphy.
He was driving with Don Murphy?
